title: The Role of Attitude toward Foreign Language Learning in Emerging Learning Contexts in Higher Education
reason: Sample is 627 learners aged 14-73 at Spanish Official Schools of Languages (Escuelas Oficiales de Idiomas), not a higher- or vocational-education programme. Secondarily, attitudes are self-reported and compared by modality, gender and age; no platform measure.

extraction.design: cross-sectional survey, comparison by learning modality
extraction.n_quote: The sample is made up of 627 foreign language students with an average age of 40.15 years.
extraction.population: foreign-language learners at Official Schools of Languages (Galicia, Andalusia, Aragon), face-to-face/blended/distance
extraction.outcome_or_construct: attitudes toward language learning (motivation, interest, self-efficacy, effort)
extraction.notes: Secondary NOREL (self-report only). Age correlations (e.g. r = -.262) are demographic, not platform indicators.
